---
title: "07.Assembly_stats"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

Assembly statistics and contig coverage (MEGAHIT assemblies, contigs ≥ 1 kb).

* `assembly_stats.tsv` (raw): `seqkit stats -a -T *.contigs.fa`.
* `contig_headers.tsv` (raw): MEGAHIT FASTA headers, `sample<TAB>contig flag=.. multi=.. len=..`;
  `multi` is the average k-mer coverage of the contig, used as its sequencing depth.

Outputs (`Data/Processed`)

* `assembly_stats.tsv`: one row per sample (contigs, assembled Mb, N50, coverage-weighted assembled Mb).
* `contig_coverage.tsv`: coverage and length of the ARG-carrying contigs.

Coverage-weighted assembled Mb = Σ(coverage × length) / 1e6 over all contigs of a sample; it is used to express
ARG-contig abundances relative to the whole assembly (as reads per million in the read-based CPM).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(data.table)
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
seqkit <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "assembly_stats.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
contig_master <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_master.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

headers <- fread(here("Data", "Raw", "Assembly", "contig_headers.tsv"), sep = "\t", header = FALSE,
                 col.names = c("sample_id", "header"), showProgress = FALSE)
```

# Parse contig headers

```{r parse headers}
headers <- as_tibble(headers) %>%
  # The first line of the raw file carries terminal control characters before the sample name
  mutate(sample_id = str_extract(sample_id, "GPH_\\d+"),
         contig_id = str_extract(header, "^\\S+"),
         coverage = as.numeric(str_match(header, "multi=([0-9.]+)")[, 2]),
         contig_length = as.integer(str_match(header, "len=(\\d+)")[, 2])) %>%
  select(-header)

stopifnot(!anyNA(headers))
cat("Contigs:", nrow(headers), "| samples:", n_distinct(headers$sample_id), "\n")
```

# Assembly statistics

```{r assembly stats}
coverage_stats <- headers %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(n_contigs = n(),
            assembly_Mb_headers = sum(contig_length) / 1e6,
            coverage_weighted_Mb = sum(coverage * contig_length) / 1e6,
            median_coverage = median(coverage),
            .groups = "drop")

assembly_stats <- seqkit %>%
  transmute(sample_id = str_remove(basename(file), "\\.contigs\\.fa.*$"),
            assembly_Mb = sum_len / 1e6,
            N50,
            max_contig_kb = max_len / 1e3) %>%
  inner_join(coverage_stats, by = "sample_id") %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% metadata$sample_id)

# seqkit and headers must describe the same assemblies
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(assembly_stats$assembly_Mb, assembly_stats$assembly_Mb_headers)))
assembly_stats <- assembly_stats %>% select(-assembly_Mb_headers)

cat("Samples:", nrow(assembly_stats), "of", nrow(metadata), "\n")
summary(assembly_stats %>% select(-sample_id))
```

# ARG contig coverage

```{r arg contigs}
contig_coverage <- contig_master %>%
  distinct(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length_kraken = contig_length) %>%
  left_join(headers, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"))

stopifnot(!anyNA(contig_coverage$coverage),
          all(contig_coverage$contig_length == contig_coverage$contig_length_kraken))

contig_coverage <- contig_coverage %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length, coverage)
summary(contig_coverage$coverage)
```

# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(assembly_stats, here("Data", "Processed", "assembly_stats.tsv"))
write_tsv(contig_coverage, here("Data", "Processed", "contig_coverage.tsv"))
```
